skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts in psychology and their role in business operations.
Identify the psychological characteristics of tourists and other participants in tourism activities.
Utilize effective communication skills in serving tourists and other business activities.
Develop positive relationships with customers and colleagues in tourism activities.
Apply listening skills effectively in tourism business operations.
Produce well-written texts commonly used in tourism and hospitality businesses.
Deliver persuasive presentations in tourism business settings.
Analyze the psychological characteristics of different tourist groups based on nationality, age, gender, profession, and travel purpose.
